_meta.purpose: A homeowner's smart camera/lock/hub system with a cloud backend and a third-party analytics vendor. All flows Process-mediated so every interaction is reachable with no mapping-table caveats.

flows.description: Homeowner registers account and enrolls cameras/sensors on the Home Hub
Guest enters a temporary access code at the Home Hub to unlock the front door
Home Hub writes motion/door/sensor events to the local event log
Home Hub uploads recorded camera clips to cloud video storage
Home Hub forwards a real-time motion alert to the mobile app backend
Mobile app backend pushes a motion-detected notification to the homeowner's phone
Mobile app backend shares aggregated device-usage analytics with the cloud analytics vendor
Mobile app backend retrieves a stored video clip for the homeowner to play back
